notes.title: Dimension Warrior – Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
[b]New Features & Improvements:[/b]  [list][*][b]Removed graphics quality options[/b] – The game now automatically applies the best visual and performance settings.[/*][*][b]Added hit visual effect[/b] – Enemies now display a visual effect when hit by the player.[/*][*][b]Improved in-game terminal[/b] – Now shows short instructions to explain the basic mechanics of the game.[/*][*][b]Practice Mode[/b] – Allows players to practice boss fights and learn game mechanics. A blocking indicator has been added to show the correct timing for blocking.[/*][*][b]"Normal Mode"[/b] – The default game mode now has a proper name.[/*][*][b]New keybinding options[/b] – Players can now freely rebind keys on both keyboard and gamepad.[/*][*][b]Improved lighting quality[/b] – Enhanced lighting on the final map.[/*][*][b]Terminal repositioned[/b] – The in-game terminal has been moved closer to the doors.[/*][/list]
Thanks for your support and feedback! 🚀

tags.feature: - Added hit visual effect – Enemies now display a visual effect when hit by the player.
- Improved in-game terminal – Now shows short instructions to explain the basic mechanics of the game.
- Practice Mode – Allows players to practice boss fights and learn game mechanics. A blocking indicator has been added to show the correct timing for blocking.
- "Normal Mode" – The default game mode now has a proper name.
- New keybinding options – Players can now freely rebind keys on both keyboard and gamepad.
- Improved lighting quality – Enhanced lighting on the final map.
- Terminal repositioned – The in-game terminal has been moved closer to the doors.
